correctness.rationale: The proof uses the partition of the three marked left vertices as states 0,1,2. An added right vertex creates a cycle precisely if it joins two already-connected left terminals. Therefore the only merging moves have multiplicities 3,1 from state 0 and 2 from state 1, with four nonmerging moves in each state. The completion recurrences Z0,Z1,Z2 follow by selecting at most two ordered merges. Marked-column inclusion counts Z, A, BR, BL, BD then yield the three exact covariance numerators. Independently checked all 3 integer coefficient identities and brute enumerated all 2^(3n) edge subsets for n=2,3,4,5, matching total and marked counts. All numerators are manifestly negative on n>=2, and polynomial degree yields the stated asymptotics. This establishes only uniform unweighted forests, not weighted Rayleigh or all-graph negative association.

value.rationale: The conjectural negative edge correlation of uniform forests is a natural nontrivial graph-probability problem. K_{3,n} for n>=3 forms an infinite family of 3-connected non-series-parallel graphs, so the classification genuinely goes beyond the proved series-parallel regime and finite small-graph certificates. Exact covariance by all three pair orbits and distinct limiting scales are independent quantitative information useful for future family-wise and potential weighted generalizations.
